summary: Verified kiosk perf-optimization PR (iter74): parallel loading, 30s backend cache + invalidation on mutations, localStorage prefetch cache, lazy Stripe. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass covering GET /kiosk/apartments shape+filters (location_id, _none), /kiosk/locations counts, cache invalidation after POST /apartments reflects new apt immediately, PUT /kiosk/customer-display heartbeat does NOT clear cache (returns 200), /kiosk/tenants/{id}/overview full structure + 404 for unknown tenant, and /admin/stats. Frontend: PIN 4321 login → localStorage key kiosk_select_cache_v1 populated with {apartments:5, locations:2} after first fetch; reload serves cache instantly; location picker renders 'Filiaal — Nieuw Nickerie (1 appt)' + 'Hoofdvestiging — Paramaribo (4 appt)'; opening Hoofdvestiging shows apt cards with correct pay badges (HUIS 1A=Niet betaald/unpaid, 1B=Betaald, 2C=Deels betaald/partial, Penthouse=Betaald) — exactly matching backend pay_status. Stripe.js scripts list in page is [] on PIN/location/apt-select steps, confirming Stripe is only loaded at the payment step as planned.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/apartments requires admin access_token; a plain /auth/kiosk-pin session (cookie kiosk_token only) gets 401 'Niet ingelogd'. The AddApartmentModal catch-block sets err but after the 401 the kiosk app appears to drop back to the location picker instead of showing the error in-modal (verified by curl: 401 'Niet ingelogd'). This likely still works for personal-PIN employee sessions that carry both access_token+kiosk_token, but is broken for the shared 4321 PIN. Pre-existing issue, not caused by this PR.

action_items: Decide if Appt. quick-create button should be hidden for shared-PIN kiosk sessions, OR allow POST /apartments from a kiosk_token (adding `get_current_user_or_kiosk` style dep). Right now shared-PIN users see the button, fill the form, click save and get silently bounced to the picker.
Nice-to-have: emit a toast error in AddApartmentModal when api.post('/apartments') fails so the user understands what happened instead of landing back on the picker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _live_sync_broadcast (~L771): clearing _KIOSK_CACHE on every non-GET to any /api/* path EXCEPT _CACHE_KEEP_PATHS is correct and already excludes /kiosk/customer-display + /kiosk/employee-verify + /api/admin/events — nice. BUT the clear happens *before* the status_code<400 guard check… actually re-reading: it's inside `if response.status_code < 400 and not path.startswith(_CACHE_KEEP_PATHS)` so 4xx won't clear — good.

_kiosk_cached uses `json.dumps(sc, sort_keys=True, default=str)` as key — fine, but note that if two companies ever share the same sc dict (shouldn't) collisions are theoretically possible. The key is per-company via kiosk_scope so OK.

_kiosk_apartments_compute uses `kiosk_scope` scoping on apartments and tenants join via `{"id":{"$in":tids}}` — missing company scope on tenants lookup. If two companies had colliding tenant ids (uuid, very unlikely) data could leak. Low risk but worth a scope filter for defense-in-depth.

kiosk_tenant_overview excellent parallel pattern via asyncio.gather. Confirmed response contains all required blocks (tenant, apartment, balance, credit_balance, open_invoices, current_invoices, future_invoices, *_total, fines_total, has_history, due_reminders).

lib/kiosk-cache.js: `prefetchKioskSelect` guards on localStorage.getItem('kiosk_token') — but the real cookie is httpOnly `kiosk_token`, not accessible to JS. There IS a localStorage flag that gets set elsewhere; verify it's set before prefetch runs or the first-after-login prefetch may silently no-op (observed cache DID populate in test so it works, just confirming the check isn't redundant/incorrect).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on in-scope checks (cache, pay badges, Stripe lazy)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Kiosk PIN 4321, slug my-awesome-rentals-bv. Login flow: /{slug}/login?target=kiosk → click 'Terug naar PIN' if beheerder-login shown first → tap digit buttons. localStorage key: kiosk_select_cache_v1 (schema: {scope, apartments:[], locations:[]}). The seed in this preview has 5 apartments / 2 locations (Hoofdvestiging has HUIS 1A/1B/2C/Penthouse; Filiaal has Studio 1). Pay badges in UI: Niet betaald=unpaid, Deels betaald=partial, Betaald=paid. Backend _KIOSK_CACHE TTL=30s, cleared by middleware on any successful non-GET /api/* except _CACHE_KEEP_PATHS=(/api/kiosk/customer-display, /api/kiosk/employee-verify, /api/admin/events).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A for the in-scope PR; one pre-existing side observation: POST /api/apartments requires access_token (admin JWT) so the kiosk 'Appt.' quick-create modal is non-functional for a shared-PIN kiosk session. Reproduce: curl /api/auth/kiosk-pin 200 → curl POST /api/apartments → 401 'Niet ingelogd'. Mitigation: either add kiosk-aware auth dep on POST /apartments, or hide the Appt. button when the session only has kiosk_token.
